from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width and full-height lines mark the separators.
    row_bars = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_bars = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = grid[row_bars[0]][0] if row_bars else (grid[0][col_bars[0]] if col_bars else None)
    rb = [r for r in row_bars if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    cb = [c for c in col_bars if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n, bars):
        out=[]; start=0
        for b in bars:
            if start < b: out.append((start,b))
            start=b+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs, cs = spans(h, rb), spans(w, cb)
    bg = None
    # Background is the most common non-separator color.
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    candidates=[]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rs):
      for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cs):
        patch=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
        n=sum(x != bg for row in patch for x in row)
        candidates.append((n,ri,ci,patch))
    _, sri, sci, patch=max(candidates)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rs):
      for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cs):
        if ri==sri and ci==sci: continue
        if r1-r0 != len(patch) or c1-c0 != len(patch[0]): continue
        for dr in range(len(patch)):
          out[r0+dr][c0:c1]=patch[dr][:]
    return out
'''
f=programs/'task-23fc5d93.py'; f.write_text(code)
